summary: Frontend-only smoke + regression testing of the Orbit rebrand + Play-Store-style /appstore redesign, lite/pro removal, Digital tabs, sidebar cleanup, and login flows. All requested flows PASSED. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: AppStore.jsx is ~420 lines with two large exports (AppStore + AppStoreDetail); consider splitting AppStoreDetail into its own file for maintainability.
seedAppStore filter logic in AppStore.jsx duplicates category filtering that could be memoized via useMemo (minor perf/clarity).
Featured banner unconditionally uses a single Unsplash hero (FEATURED_IMG) even when featured app changes — consider tying image to featured app for consistency.

AppStoreDetail description appends fixed marketing copy ('Built for the Bangladeshi market... optimized for the Robi network') to every app — content bleeds legacy Robi/telecom branding into the rebranded 'Orbit' storyline; consider genericising.
test_credentials: developer@orbit.com / dev123 ; admin@orbit.com / admin123 ; OTP: any 4 digits
seed_data_creation: None. Used fresh browser context; localStorage seed v6 loaded automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified /appstore Play-Store layout: 9 apps only (all WEB/ANDROID types; no SMS/Lite: no 'Weather Alert BD','Daily Hadith','Prayer Time Alert','Stock Market Brief','News Bangla 24x7','Daily Health Tips','QuizBD' store entry). Chips [For you, Top charts, New, E-Commerce, Education, Health, Food & Dining, Fitness, Sports, Matrimony, News, Entertainment] all present. Filtering + search work; chip-For you restores rows view. Featured banner + Editor's Choice pill present. Detail page opens (/appstore/AS-*), CTA 'Open' for web / 'Install' for android, back-store returns. OTP sign-in modal (otp-phone->otp-send->otp-code->otp-verify) works and shows store-user badge. Login: correct dev creds -> /dashboard, admin -> /admin, wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' toast. Developer sidebar links = [Dashboard, App Store, Reports, Digital, My Apps, Add-Ons] (NO Provisioning/Lite). OrbitMark SVG present in sidebar. /my-apps header = 'My Apps (9)' — no QuizBD. /digital shows only tab-web (default active) + tab-android; tab-pro does NOT exist; switching between tabs works. Detail page icon size 112x112 (not stretched).
